title: Sam was an informative,...
text: Sam was an informative, funny and friendly guide. We all enjoyed our tour. Highly recommend this tour when in Seville.
author: Sana_A

title: Sevilla Alcázar tour with Samael
text: We toured the Alcázar, cathedral and Giralda tower over the course of 3 hours. What a tour full of beautiful sites and fascinating history, but Samael was the person who made our tour unforgettable. He weaved deep historical facts, humor, and friendliness well and throughout the tour. He was incredibly inviting and made it a point to know everyone's names and keep his group engaged. It was the best experience out of several tours we joined in Andalucia and my mom and I were very impressed and satisfied with our experience. I highly recommend this tour for anyone in the future and especially Sa
author: lauren_r

title: Great history and great guide
text: We had a wonderful time.  We were traveling from the US with four kids and our tour guide Sam.  Was wonderful.  He was so informative with excitement that the kids were loving it.  He kept asking the kids questions and getting their attention.  We got to see so much and learn fun history.  I highly recommend and ask for Sam!
author: codyd502

title: So good
text: Fantastic guide. I think was Helena but could have been Eleanor. Before the tour even started Oway spotted I had booked the wrong language tour and swopped us all over with no fuss after booking.com were only interested in dodging blame.
author: barrym409

title: Very knowledgeable guide exploring incredibly beautiful buildings
text: Sam was a great guide, very easy to listen to for 3 and a half hours. Learned a lot about Spanish history and culture. Incredibly beautiful places to explore.
author: Claire_W

title: Amazing tour! Learned a lot!
text: It was very informative and we loved walking through the Cathedral and the Alcázar! We also had the opportunity to climb to the top of the Geralda! Amazing views! Highly recommend this tour.
author: Keely_M

title: Great time spent!
text: Delighted we chose to visit Alcazar and Cathedral with a guide as our tour guide Sam was so full of interesting facts we just wouldn't have had the same experience. You're lucky if you get Sam, as he'll have you giggling throughout. Very friendly, very informative and a great way to spend a few hours surrounded by history. Very enjoyable
author: jameswalsh23

title: Sophia was an amazing...
text: Sophia was an amazing tour guide just like her counterpart, Olga. They provided so much information on the history of the Alcázar and the cathedral.. a great walking tour, very communicative, very accommodating and very kind!!
author: Miriam_D

title: Great experience
text: Great tour guide and easy access to the monuments. The guide was very informative and made the tour very enjoyable
author: Marjorie_R

title: A must to understanding Seville
text: Laura was such an exceptional guide. She has such deep  knowledge of Seville and gave great details to what we were seeing. Tours like this gives a broader richer understanding to what you are seeing.  Furthermore Laura is funny and kind!!!
